key_moments: Ruben Vargas scored immediately after halftime to give Switzerland the lead (46').
Johan Manzambi extended Switzerland's lead to 2-0 with a goal in the 57th minute.
Promise David pulled one back for Canada in the 76th minute, making it 2-1.
Yellow cards were issued to Cyle Larin (Canada) and Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) in the 31st minute for unsporting behavior.

standout_performers.reason: Scored a goal and provided an assist, contributing to both Swiss goals.
Opened the scoring with a crucial goal right after the break.
Scored Canada's only goal, keeping their hopes alive late in the match.

matches.tactical_summary: Switzerland capitalized on a strong start to the second half, scoring two quick goals to establish a commanding lead. Canada struggled to break down the Swiss defense for much of the game but found a late consolation goal, showcasing resilience despite the deficit.

narrative: Switzerland secured the top spot in Group B with a decisive 2-1 victory over Canada, demonstrating their clinical finishing in the second half. Despite the loss, Canada's superior goal difference from earlier matches ensured they finished second in the group, advancing to the knockout stages alongside Switzerland.
